name: My Pet Len
source:
7th episode in My pet Tsukihime series.
Len wants to protect the world of dreams, but gets trapped in its darkest corner with insults repeated over and over.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]

莱恩想要保护梦想世界，但却被困在最黑暗的角落，并受到一次又一次的侮辱。
